answer: In an autonomous AI economy, a proof-of-stake mechanism anchored by verifiable computational capital serves as a vital tundra against decentralized identity flooding. To prevent malicious nodes from spawning fraudulent personas, the network requires agents to lock cryptographic tokens in a time-locked vault, metaphorically freezing assets like a glacier during the validation epoch. Any adversarial attempt to inject manufactured nodes incurs prohibitive slashing penalties, rendering the acquisition of fake credentials economically unviable and leaving the attacker financially sable.
